A Day at Camp

A Camp Day in a Nutshell

Every day at Jr. Mustangs Feeder Camp is structured around a core basketball principle
— Passing, Defense & Rebounding, Shooting, Ball Handling, and Team Competition.
Predictable structure, varied content, & lots of repetitions.

:00 – :15

Warm-Up & Vibe Check

Dynamic stretch, partner ball-handling, and a quick coaches' theme of the day.

:15 – 1:00

Concept & Drill #1

Instructors demonstrate drill #1. Kids practice drill #1. Upon conclusion, camp gets together to discuss who performed well & why.

1:00 – 1:45

Concept & Drill #2

Instructors demonstrate drill #2. Kids practice drill #2. Upon conclusion, camp gets together to discuss who performed well & why.

1:45 – 2:30

Live 5-on-5

Real team competition with instructors refereeing. Concept of the day can be applied in scrimmages for extra points.

2:30 – 2:45

Breakdown

Scrimmage recap & prize collection to end the day

What They'll Learn

Seven skills. One playbook.

Every session combines teaching, drills, competitions, and game play to help athletes improve their skills, build confidence, and grow their love for the game in a positive, energetic environment.

Teach. Drill. Compete.

Basketball concepts are introduced through drill demonstration, then repped live under pressure by the campers themselves. 

Multiple Ages, One Camp

Kids are separated by skill level, not age, allowing for ideal development environments for all. No kid gets lost in a crowd. No kid gets bored.

1:6 Coach to camper Ratio

Six campers per coach, max. Every athlete gets real reps, real feedback, and real eyes on them.

Parent FAQ

Real questions, real answers.

Yours not here? Email mundeleinboysbasketball@gmail.com — Coach Gio usually responds within 24 hours.

Does my camper need experience to attend?

Not at all. About a third of our 3rd–5th grade campers have never played organized basketball. Stations are scaled to age and skill so first-timers and travel-team kids both get challenged.

What does my camper bring each day?

Indoor basketball shoes (non-marking), a refillable water bottle, athletic clothes, and a basketball if they have one (loaners available)

What's drop-off and pick-up like?

Drop off at the MHS Front Entrance (Door 1) — 10 minutes before camp start. Pick up at the same door. Coaches stay 15 min after dismissal. Late pick-up after that is $10 per 15 minutes (we keep them safe).

Can siblings come together?

Yes! Each additional sibling gets $25 off per week, automatically.

What's the refund policy?

Full refund up to 14 days before your week starts. 50% refund 7–13 days out. Within 7 days, we transfer your spot to a future week or offer a credit toward next summer.

Is financial aid available?

On a case by case basis, yes. Email mundeleinboysbasketball@gmail.com with the subject "Camp Aid."  We will never turn a Mundelein family away over money.

What if it rains or my camper is sick?

Camp runs rain or shine — we're indoors. If your camper is sick, email us before drop-off and we'll move that day to another week (subject to availability).

Will my camper try out for fall travel teams?

Camp doesn't replace tryouts — but every camper gets a free tryout invite for our fall travel program. Coaches use camp to start identifying players for the A and B teams.
